worldcombat.skill.eeriespell.summary: Fires a spell that damages the target and disrupts its attacks. Pokémon also lose PP from their last move; ordinary attacks can fumble too. Aim at a target or just fire in one direction.
worldcombat.skill.eeriespell.description: Fires a spell up to %2$s blocks away, dealing about %1$s special damage on hit. Aim at a target or just fire in one direction.
On hit, applies Eerie for %2$s and removes %1$s PP from a Pokémon target’s last move.
While Eerie, each move attempt or ordinary attack hit has a %1$s chance to fail, dealing no damage on that attempt; a real fumble shows a one-time interrupt mark on the target.
Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to cast the spell; when off it stays put.
